_doc: Knacks: one passive per evolution line. 'knacks' defines each (name, desc, battle msg with {name}/{other}, and hook fields read by battle/knacks.gd); 'species' maps every species id to its line's knack. Legends have their own.

thick_fleece.name: Thick Fleece
thick_fleece.desc: Frost moves and chills can't get through its coat.
thick_fleece.msg: {name}'s Thick Fleece kept the frost out!

frost_hardy.name: Frost Hardy
frost_hardy.desc: Never chilled, and half as fast again in a frost.
frost_hardy.msg: {name} is Frost Hardy and shrugs off the cold!

early_riser.name: Early Riser
early_riser.desc: Up with the lark: its Speed rises when it comes out at dawn or in sunshine.
early_riser.msg: {name} is an Early Riser and already up and about!

puddle_jumper.name: Puddle Jumper
puddle_jumper.desc: Half as fast again in drizzle or a downpour.

gale_rider.name: Gale Rider
gale_rider.desc: Half as fast again in a gale.

weather_eye.name: Weather Eye
weather_eye.desc: Weather it calls up lasts 8 turns instead of 5.

stiff_upper_lip.name: Stiff Upper Lip
stiff_upper_lip.desc: Never flinches, and foes can't lower its stats.

moaner.name: Moaner
moaner.desc: Has a good moan when it comes out, lowering the foes' Attack.
moaner.msg: {name} is having a right old moan. It's putting everyone off!

bog_standard.name: Bog Standard
bog_standard.desc: Heals 1/8 of its HP each turn in drizzle or a downpour.
bog_standard.msg: {name} soaks up the rain. Bog Standard!

sun_trap.name: Sun Trap
sun_trap.desc: Heals 1/8 of its HP each turn in sunshine.
sun_trap.msg: {name} basks in the sun and perks up.

pea_souper.name: Pea Souper
pea_souper.desc: Melts into the murk: foes find it a fifth harder to hit in fog.

keen_eye.name: Keen Eye
keen_eye.desc: Fog doesn't spoil its aim, and its accuracy can't be lowered.

bristleback.name: Bristleback
bristleback.desc: Anyone who hits it with a physical move gets pricked for 1/8 of their HP, and foes can't lower its stats.
bristleback.msg_drop: {name} bristles. It won't be put off that easily!

riverwise.name: Riverwise
riverwise.desc: Half as fast again in drizzle or a downpour, and draining and healing moves heal it half as much again.

squirrelled_away.name: Squirrelled Away
squirrelled_away.desc: Its own-type moves hit half as hard again at a third of its HP or less, and it patches itself up for an eighth of its HP when it switches out.
squirrelled_away.msg_switch: {name} nips off to its stash and comes back a bit perkier.

prickly.name: Prickly
prickly.desc: Anyone who hits it with a physical move gets pricked for 1/8 of their HP.

tough_old_boots.name: Tough as Old Boots
tough_old_boots.desc: At full HP, a knockout blow leaves it hanging on with 1 HP.
tough_old_boots.msg: {name} is Tough as Old Boots and hangs on!

backs_to_wall.name: Backs to the Wall
backs_to_wall.desc: Its own-type moves hit half as hard again at a third of its HP or less.

mardy.name: Mardy
mardy.desc: In a right mood when it has a status: its moves hit harder.

cocky.name: Cocky
cocky.desc: Knocking a foe out goes to its head: its Attack rises.

night_owl.name: Night Owl
night_owl.desc: Can't be put to sleep, and hits harder at dusk and at night.
night_owl.msg: {name} is a Night Owl and won't nod off!

waterproof.name: Waterproof
waterproof.desc: Can't be soaked, and brook and tide moves hurt it a quarter less.

shake_it_off.name: Shake It Off
shake_it_off.desc: A one in three chance each turn to shake off a status.

grazer.name: Grazer
grazer.desc: Nibbles away between moves: heals 1/16 of its HP every turn.
grazer.msg: {name} has a quick graze and feels better.

sun_seeker.name: Sun Seeker
sun_seeker.desc: Its moves hit harder in sunshine.

storm_chaser.name: Storm Chaser
storm_chaser.desc: Its storm, brook and tide moves hit harder in drizzle or a downpour.

make_do_and_mend.name: Make Do and Mend
make_do_and_mend.desc: Patches itself up for a quarter of its HP when it switches out.
make_do_and_mend.msg: {name} makes do and mends on the way out.

hard_hat.name: Hard Hat
hard_hat.desc: Takes no recoil, and stone moves hurt it a quarter less.

hearty_appetite.name: Hearty Appetite
hearty_appetite.desc: Draining and healing moves heal it half as much again.

lucky_heather.name: Lucky Heather
lucky_heather.desc: Twice as likely to land a critical hit.

sea_legs.name: Sea Legs
sea_legs.desc: Bad weather never weakens its moves.

strength_in_numbers.name: Strength in Numbers
strength_in_numbers.desc: Hits a quarter harder with a partner beside it in a double battle.

solid_as_rock.name: Solid as a Rock
solid_as_rock.desc: Super-effective hits do a quarter less to it.

ravens_stay.name: The Ravens Stay
ravens_stay.desc: While the ravens stay the kingdom stands: it can't be knocked out from full HP in one blow, and foes can't lower its stats.
ravens_stay.msg: {name} will not fall. The ravens stay!
ravens_stay.msg_drop: {name} won't be cowed. The ravens stay!

silver_shoes.name: Silver Shoes
silver_shoes.desc: A rider asleep and a horse that is not: it can't be put to sleep, and its blows land harder at dusk and at night.
silver_shoes.msg: {name}'s shoes ring out across the water, and it will not nod off!

loch_mist.name: Loch Mist
loch_mist.desc: Rises with a mist that lasts 5 turns, and is hard to hit in fog.
loch_mist.msg: {name} rises from the loch, and a mist comes with it!

red_dragon.name: Y Ddraig Goch
red_dragon.desc: Burns the clouds away on arrival (sunshine for 5 turns), and fights hotter in the sun.
red_dragon.msg: {name} breathes fire and the clouds burn away!

black_shuck.name: Black Shuck
black_shuck.desc: Brings a downpour for 5 turns, and its howl slows both foes.
black_shuck.msg: {name} howls up a storm. Everyone's hackles rise!

phantom_queen.name: Phantom Queen
phantom_queen.desc: Looms over the field when it arrives: both foes' Attack and Lore drop.
phantom_queen.msg: {name} looms over the field. The foes lose heart!

third_bark.name: The Third Bark
third_bark.desc: Its moves hit half as hard again against a foe at half HP or less.

green_return.name: Green Man's Return
green_return.desc: Puts out new growth: heals 1/8 of its HP every turn, and often sheds a status.
green_return.msg_shake: {name} grows clean out of its trouble.

hernes_hunt.name: Herne's Hunt
hernes_hunt.desc: The hunt quickens: its Speed rises at the end of every turn.
hernes_hunt.msg: {name} picks up the scent. The hunt quickens!

worm_rejoins.name: The Worm Rejoins
worm_rejoins.desc: Once a battle it survives a knockout blow, and it knits itself back together a little every turn.

older_than_hills.name: Older than the Hills
older_than_hills.desc: Super-effective hits barely trouble it, and foes can't lower its stats.
older_than_hills.msg: {name} has seen it all before. It won't be moved!

fair_folk.name: Fair Folk Glamour
fair_folk.desc: Hard to pin down (foes' accuracy x0.85), and it can't be muddled.

white_horses.name: White Horses
white_horses.desc: Gallops in with a drizzle for 5 turns, and is half as fast again in the rain.
white_horses.msg: {name} gallops in on the white horses, and the rain follows!

away_with_the_fairies.name: Away with the Fairies
away_with_the_fairies.desc: Can't be muddled (it already is), and harder to hit in fog.
away_with_the_fairies.msg: {name} is Away with the Fairies and barely notices!

spore_cloud.name: Spore Cloud
spore_cloud.desc: Every raindrop sets off a puff, so it's harder to hit in drizzle or a downpour.

right_pong.name: Right Pong
right_pong.desc: Arrives reeking. Foes lose Attack holding their noses.
right_pong.msg: {name} brings a Right Pong with it. Everyone is holding their nose!

already_burnt.name: Already Burnt
already_burnt.desc: Hearth moves do less to it. You can't burn what's already charcoal.
already_burnt.msg: {name} is Already Burnt. It hardly notices!

shelf_life.name: Shelf Life
shelf_life.desc: Brackets last for years: from full health it hangs on at 1 HP.

brass_neck.name: Brass Neck
brass_neck.desc: Has the brass neck to carry on regardless: foes can't lower its stats, and it can't be muddled.
brass_neck.msg: {name} has a right Brass Neck and carries on regardless!

we_are_flitting.name: Aye, We're Flitting
we_are_flitting.desc: Gets under everyone's feet when it arrives, lowering the foes' Speed, and comes along for the ride when it switches out, healing 1/8 of its HP.
we_are_flitting.msg: {name} gets under everyone's feet. What a nuisance!
we_are_flitting.msg_switch: A voice from the milk churn: "Aye, we're flitting!" {name} perks up.

forced_in_the_dark.name: Forced in the Dark
forced_in_the_dark.desc: Grows best out of the light: hits harder at dusk and at night, and grows back 1/16 of its HP every turn.
forced_in_the_dark.msg: You can hear {name} creak as it grows.

fired_hard.name: Fired Hard
fired_hard.desc: Kiln-fired at 1,200 degrees: hearth and frost moves hurt it a quarter less.
fired_hard.msg: {name} is Fired Hard. It barely felt that!

ochre_water.name: Ochre Water
ochre_water.desc: Lives in rusty water: it can't be soaked, and heals 1/16 of its HP each turn in drizzle or a downpour.

beheading_game.name: Beheading Game
beheading_game.desc: Picks its head back up: from full HP a knockout blow leaves it on 1 HP, and its own-type moves hit half as hard again at a third of its HP or less.

drag_you_under.name: Drag You Under
drag_you_under.desc: Its moves hit a third harder against a foe at half HP or less.

switched_on.name: Switched On
switched_on.desc: Lights up when it comes out at dusk or at night: its Lore rises.
switched_on.msg: {name} is Switched On! The whole prom lights up.

another_tide.name: Another Tide
another_tide.desc: Brook and tide moves hurt it a quarter less, and foes can't lower its stats.
another_tide.msg: {name} has stood through a thousand tides. It won't be moved!

broad_gauge.name: Broad Gauge
broad_gauge.desc: Built wide and steady: foes can't lower its stats, and super-effective hits do a little less to it.
broad_gauge.msg: {name} runs on the Broad Gauge. It won't be shifted!

hot_air.name: Hot Air
hot_air.desc: Rises on a warm day: half as fast again in sunshine, and frost moves hurt it a quarter less.

overnight_job.name: Overnight Job
overnight_job.desc: Does its best work in the dark: its moves hit harder at dusk and at night, and it can't be muddled.
overnight_job.msg: {name} keeps a clear head. Nobody saw a thing.

blowhole.name: Blowhole
blowhole.desc: Booms in on a squall that brings drizzle for 5 turns, and its storm and tide moves hit harder in the rain.
blowhole.msg: {name} booms through the rock, and a squall blows in!

copper_smoke.name: Copper Smoke
copper_smoke.desc: Arrives in a cloud of copper smoke that lowers the foes' Defence.
copper_smoke.msg: {name} belches copper smoke over the field. Everyone's coughing!

pwnco.name: Pwnco
pwnco.desc: Comes to the door with a rhyme: the foes' Lore drops, and it can't be muddled.
pwnco.msg: {name} knocks and sings a rhyme at the door. The foes can't think of a comeback!

footing.name: Footing
footing.desc: Turf dries best in the wind and sun: its Defence rises when it comes out in a gale or in sunshine.
footing.msg: {name} is well footed and drying nicely. Its Defence rose!

atlantic_edge.name: Atlantic Edge
atlantic_edge.desc: Its moves hit harder in a gale off the Atlantic.

evil_eye.name: Evil Eye
evil_eye.desc: The great eye opens when it arrives: both foes' Defence and Ward drop.
evil_eye.msg: {name} opens its terrible eye. Everything it looks at wilts!

red_hot.name: Red Hot
red_hot.desc: Fresh from the furnace: anyone who hits it with a physical move gets scorched for 1/8 of their HP.

adaptable.name: Adaptable
adaptable.desc: Suits itself to anything: a third as fast again in any weather but a clear sky.

devils_chair.name: The Devil's Chair
devils_chair.desc: When the mist is down he is in his chair: foes find it a fifth harder to hit in fog, and they can't lower its stats.

time_eater.name: Time Eater
time_eater.desc: Gobbles the foes' time: their Speed drops when it comes out.
time_eater.msg: {name} takes a bite out of the clock. Everyone slows down!

keen_as_mustard.name: Keen as Mustard
keen_as_mustard.desc: Raring to go: its Attack rises when it comes out.

flooded_diggings.name: Flooded Diggings
flooded_diggings.desc: Every hole it digs fills with water: heals 1/8 of its HP each turn in drizzle or a downpour, and can't be soaked.
flooded_diggings.msg: {name}'s diggings fill up with rain. It looks refreshed.

never_photographed.name: Never Photographed
never_photographed.desc: Hard to pin down in fog (foes' accuracy x0.8), and hits harder at dusk and at night.

the_wake.name: The Wake
the_wake.desc: Never taken: from full HP it hangs on through a knockout blow, and foes can't lower its stats.
the_wake.msg: {name} slips away into the reeds and comes back fighting!

hill_figure.name: Hill Figure
hill_figure.desc: Cut into the hillside: foes can't lower its stats, and it fades into the fog.
hill_figure.msg: {name} stands its ground like a Hill Figure!
hill_figure.msg_drop: {name} is cut into the hill. It won't be moved!

kiln_dried.name: Kiln Dried
kiln_dried.desc: Can't be soaked, and its moves hit harder in sunshine.
kiln_dried.msg: {name} is Kiln Dried and warm right through!

regency_swagger.name: Regency Swagger
regency_swagger.desc: Sweeps in showing off: its Lore rises when it comes out.

knapped_edge.name: Knapped Edge
knapped_edge.desc: Anyone who hits it with a physical move gets cut on its flint for 1/8 of their HP.

knucker_hole.name: Knucker Hole
knucker_hole.desc: Rises from its bottomless pool with a drizzle for 5 turns, and heals 1/8 of its HP each turn in the wet.
knucker_hole.msg: {name} rises dripping from the Knucker Hole!

cheeky_imp.name: Cheeky Imp
cheeky_imp.desc: Pulls a face from up on its pillar when it arrives: both foes' Ward drops.
cheeky_imp.msg: {name} pulls a face from up on its pillar. Everyone is rattled!

armour_plate.name: Armour Plate
armour_plate.desc: Takes no recoil, and iron and stone moves hurt it a quarter less.

eagre.name: Eagre
eagre.desc: Rides in on the weather: its storm and tide moves hit harder in drizzle, a downpour or a gale.

rooted.name: Rooted
rooted.desc: Four thousand years in one spot: foes can't lower its stats, and super-effective hits do a fifth less.
rooted.msg: {name} is Rooted. It won't be moved!

lure_light.name: Lure Light
lure_light.desc: Its little lamp works best in the dark: its moves hit harder at dusk and at night.

high_girders.name: The High Girders
high_girders.desc: Comes in on a gale that lasts 5 turns, and is half as fast again in a gale.
high_girders.msg: {name} rattles in on the storm, lamps blazing!

waterlogged.name: Waterlogged
waterlogged.desc: Soaked through already: Brook and Tide moves do less to it.
waterlogged.msg: {name} is Waterlogged. It just soaks it up!

tide_race.name: Tide Race
tide_race.desc: Rides the rough water: harder to hit in a gale.

foul_breath.name: Foul Breath
foul_breath.desc: Arrives breathing out. Foes lose Attack holding their noses.
foul_breath.msg: {name} yawns. The Foul Breath rolls over everyone!

blighting_breath.name: Blighting Breath
blighting_breath.desc: Its breath withers all it touches: foes lose Defence when it arrives.
blighting_breath.msg: {name}'s Blighting Breath rolls across the field!

not_quite_extinct.name: Not Quite Extinct
not_quite_extinct.desc: At full HP, a knockout blow leaves it hanging on with 1 HP.

thick_rind.name: Thick Rind
thick_rind.desc: A good waxed rind: foes can't lower its stats, and brook and tide moves hurt it a quarter less.
thick_rind.msg_drop: {name}'s rind is far too thick to dent!

cwm_mizzle.name: Cwm Mizzle
cwm_mizzle.desc: Valley drizzle puts a song in the rock: its stone and fae moves hit harder in drizzle, fog or a downpour.
cwm_mizzle.msg: {name} knocks, and the mizzle sings back!

full_head.name: Full Head of Steam
full_head.desc: Comes out with the pressure up: its Attack rises as it arrives.
full_head.msg: {name} arrives with a full head of steam!
